ideas.topic: The Hidden Diet of Pyramid Builders
ideas.hook: Forget the myths of slave labor; ancient Egyptian pyramid workers were actually eating better than the average person of their time.
ideas.why: It subverts a popular misconception about pyramid construction while focusing on relatable daily life, a proven high-interest topic.

ideas.topic: Why Ancient Egyptians Wore Wigs in the Heat
ideas.hook: If you think wearing a heavy wig in the desert sun sounds like a nightmare, you’ve been looking at ancient Egypt all wrong.
ideas.why: It addresses a visual curiosity about Egyptian fashion and grooming, mirroring the success of videos focusing on personal appearance and daily culture.

ideas.topic: The Mystery of the Missing Noses on Statues
ideas.hook: Why do so many ancient Egyptian statues show up in museums today with their noses deliberately chiseled off?
ideas.why: This touches on the 'mystery' and 'science/history' angle similar to reconstruction videos, while offering an intriguing explanation about ancient iconoclasm.
